song.title: Don't Look Back in Anger oasis

guitar.modelsText: Epiphone Sheraton / Gibson ES-355 / Gibson Les Paul
guitar.notes: Noel Gallagher's Epiphone Sheraton (Union Jack edition) and Gibson ES-355/Les Pauls are iconic and well documented.

tone.target: jangly Vox-style Britpop rhythm with light crunch
tone.profile: jangly Vox-style Britpop rhythm with light crunch
tone.summary: A bright, chimey signal chain using a light overdrive for warmth, followed by an AC30-style amp into a 2x12 cab, finished with minimal reverb.

rig.name: Oasis - Don't Look Back in Anger oasis - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide light, warm breakup and sustain for the open chords.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to emulate a mild boost/overdrive suitable for Britpop's gentle crunch, as no dedicated clean boost was available.
The Green OD handles the required light breakup; no dedicated drive is necessary.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Vox AC30 sound for bright, chimey tones.

blocks.gap: While a dedicated AC30 cab might be ideal, the Foxy 2x12 provides the necessary size and voicing for the bright Britpop tone.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the bright chime and cut excessive low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the frequency response for maximum clarity and 'jangly' quality.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No wah needed for this rhythm style).
blocks.gap: The tone is focused on clean strumming and chime, making a wah pedal unnecessary.
The verdict explicitly advises dropping the chorus.

blocks.purpose: Provide a modest sense of space without sounding overly wet or dramatic.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is chosen for its natural, subtle decay, fitting the 'modest room/reverb' requirement.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the Vox/Britpop chime.

proposals.reason: Better captures the specific voicing and chime of a Vox cabinet.
